script: When Damian Lillard was trying to recreate his iconic buzzer beater shot, he realized something. As when he got to the spot where the three was made, he couldn't believe this was actually how far his shot was, asking the camera if it was really that far away, and his reaction tells you that maybe Paul George was right calling it a bad shot.
